name: tavily_research_search
description:
In-depth research search through the Tavily search API (advanced depth, generated answer always included), optionally with each page's full content.
Returns {query, search_depth, topic, results_count, results: [{title, url, content (extract), score, published_date, raw_content (when include_raw_content)}], answer}.
Inputs (* required): query* (string), topic (general | science | finance; default general; passed to Tavily as its topic), max_results (integer 5-20, default 10), include_raw_content (boolean, default false; adds full page text and makes the result much larger).
Slower than tavily_web_search, which suits quick lookups.
Example: {"query": "impact of Basel III endgame on US bank capital", "topic": "finance", "max_results": 10}
Needs a Tavily API key (env TAVILY_API_KEY, config tavily.api.key); without one the tool returns placeholder example.com results with a note saying demo mode.

topic.description: Research topic category for optimized results

max_results.description: Maximum number of results (higher for research)

include_raw_content.description: Include full HTML content for deeper analysis

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Uses advanced search depth for comprehensive results. Best for academic research, market analysis, and in-depth investigations. Requires Tavily API key.

input.query: transformer architecture in natural language processing

examples.description: Comprehensive topic analysis with full content
